name: Richard Attwood
features: receding fair hair, high forehead, precise tidy manner, medium build
bio: Porsche's safe pair of hands. Shared the red Salzburg 917K with Hans Herrmann at Le Mans in 1970 and drove through the rain to give Porsche its first outright win, having asked for the short tail and the small engine because he did not trust the fast cars to last.
